operations.summary: Query ad-hoc YouTube Analytics metrics and dimensions.
operations.description: Official youtubeAnalytics.reports.query (GET /v2/reports). Kept planned solely until typed provider-query foundation issue #2985 can provide bounded query fields without a raw-query escape hatch.
operations.approval: planned on issue #2985; no live provider call is made by this connector operation definition

operations.summary: Download generated YouTube Reporting report bytes.
operations.description: Official youtubereporting.media.download. The provider's resourceName path field is mapped to the runtime's safe multi-segment {path} placeholder, preserving the documented GET /v1/media/{+resourceName}?alt=media request without accepting an arbitrary absolute download URL.
operations.approval: read-only download; requires an explicit destination root and is bounded to 100 MiB with a SHA-256 receipt
